name: oscillator
description: A stock cycling up and down rather than trending: several 5% legs so far today, a wide high-low range, and almost no net movement to show for it. The setup for trading the same name repeatedly in a session. This is a mean-reversion signal and the opposite of 'vwap hold' — if both fire on one symbol, trust neither.

alert.title: Cyclical — trades both ways

Efficiency {efficiency} (near 0 = going nowhere net)
Price ${price}  •  VWAP ${vwap}
